Intro: Hello chef. This is the last time we'll meet.
Nadezdha always picks the winning side. Even to her own detriment, strangely. And now she is Spoiled.
She is alive. I have made sure of it. But it means we need to leave Verehn, and search for a cure.
I…. I believe that I was foolish. I have been foolish, for a long time. And with Nadezdha like this…
I cannot even pretend to be a leader, when I so passionately followed someone who would drive their people to this, then kill them for it.
If I want to stand by even one of my ideals… I think at the very least, I should save the one who opened my eyes enough to let me hold on to them.
